proposed_comments.title: Keep Debug builds from dropping the Settings search resource

confidence.rationale: The current head explicitly defaults GenerateSettingsSearchIndex to false in Debug, uses that property to skip both the producer target and the Content/EmbeddedResource items, and keeps Exists() conditions that are evaluated before the generated JSON is produced.

proposed_comments.body:
### Keep Debug builds from dropping the Settings search resource

**Severity:** `high`

The current change makes `GenerateSettingsSearchIndex` default to `false` in Debug and then uses that same property to skip both the producer target and the `Content`/`EmbeddedResource` entries for `search.index.json`. On a clean Debug build, the generated JSON is not present during project evaluation, so the resource is neither produced nor embedded; Settings search depends on `Microsoft.PowerToys.Settings.UI.Assets.search.index.json`, so Debug builds can return no Settings search results. Please model the optimization as incremental generation/resource registration instead of disabling the producer and resource, or align this PR with the follow-up fix linked in the thread.
